title: BNPL Silver: Choosing Your Installment Term and Payment Frequency
summary: Explains how to select a BNPL Silver installment term (up to a maximum months cap not shown) and how payment frequency schedules installments on a repeated cadence for the chosen term. Also covers how the first and subsequent installments are dated after purchase approval.
